messages.content: Find me a documentary about global warming.

function.name: retrieve_scientific_paper
function.description: Fetches the details of scientific research paper based on its topic. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

year.description: Year of publishing of the research paper. If not specified, fetches the most recent paper

message.content:
Here are a few well‑known documentaries that explore global warming and climate change:

| Title | Year | Synopsis | Where to Watch |
|-------|------|----------|----------------|
| **An Inconvenient Truth** | 2006 | Former Vice‑President Al Gore’s campaign to raise awareness about climate change, featuring scientific data and personal stories. | Amazon Prime Video, iTunes, Google Play |
| **Before the Flood** | 2016 | Leonardo DiCaprio travels the world to meet scientists, activists, and leaders, documenting the impacts of climate change and possible solutions. | Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, iTunes |
| **The 11th Hour** | 2007 | Produced by Leonardo DiCaprio, this film examines the environmental crisis and offers a hopeful vision for the future. | Amazon Prime Video, iTunes |
| **Climate Change: The Facts** | 2019 | A concise, fact‑based overview of climate science, impacts, and policy options. | YouTube (official channel), Amazon Prime Video |
| **Our Planet – Climate Change** (Episode 2) | 2019 | Part of the *Our Planet* series; focuses on how climate change affects ecosystems worldwide. | Disney+ (via Hulu) |

If you’re looking for something more recent or region‑specific, let me know and I can dig up additional titles!
